title: Comorbidities of Epilepsy
brief_summary: Epilepsy is the second commonest chronic neurological disorder in developed countries, Comorbidity refers to the co-occurrence of two conditions with a greater frequency than found in the general population
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed as primary epilepsy either newly diagnosed or on AEDs
* Aged above 18 years old
* Males and females

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed as secondary epilepsy (post stroke, trauma, tumor, encephalitis, etc).
* Patients diagnosed as epilepsy syndrome
study_population: Subjects included will be chosen from Epilepsy out patient clinic and Neurology department at Assiut University Hospital.
